rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.acronym,
  i.short_name,
  i.country_id,
  i.geocode_regions_3,
  i.website,
  i.grid_id,
  i.db_pedia_url,
  i.wikidata_url
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN eu_territorial_units e
  ON i.geocode_regions_3 = e.geocode_regions
WHERE i.geocode_regions_3 = 'Nordjylland'
   OR e.description = 'Nordjylland'
ORDER BY i.institutions_name ASC

rows.question: Show the name of institutions based in Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_core_18 AS (
SELECT
  i.unics_id                                      AS unics_id,
  i.institutions_name                             AS institutions_name,
  i.geocode_regions_3                             AS geocode_regions_3,
  i.short_name                                    AS region_name,
  i.country_id                                    AS country_id,
  i.acronym                                       AS acronym,
  i.short_name                                    AS short_name,
  i.website                                       AS website
FROM institutions i
),
eu_territorial_units_key AS (
SELECT
  geocode_regions,
  description,
  geocode_level,
  nuts_version
FROM
  eu_territorial_units
)
SELECT DISTINCT i.institutions_name
FROM institutions_core_18 i
LEFT JOIN eu_territorial_units_key e
  ON i.geocode_regions_3 = e.geocode_regions
WHERE (e.description = 'Nordjylland')
   OR (i.region_name = 'Nordjylland')
   OR (i.geocode_regions_3 IN (
        SELECT geocode_regions FROM eu_territorial_units_key WHERE description = 'Nordjylland'
      ))
ORDER BY i.institutions_name

rows.question: Find projects whose subject area is “Mathematics and Statistics”

    psa.subject_area AS project_subject_areas_subject_area,
    p.unics_id AS projects_unics_id,
    p.acronym AS projects_acronym,

    p.homepage AS projects_homepage,
    p.total_cost AS projects_total_cost,

  LEFT JOIN projects p

  projects_homepage AS homepage,
  projects_total_cost AS total_cost,
  projects_ec_max_contribution AS ec_max_contribution,
  projects_framework_program AS framework_program,
  projects_objective AS objective,
  projects_principal_investigator AS principal_investigator
FROM project_subject_area_links
WHERE subject_areas_title = 'Mathematics and Statistics'

rows.question: Show the name of members in projects costing less than the average project cost.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_rowlevel AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.title,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    p.ec_fund_scheme,
    p.framework_program,
    p.total_cost,
    p.ec_max_contribution,
    p.acronym,
    p.principal_investigator
  FROM projects p
)
SELECT DISTINCT pm.member_name
FROM projects_rowlevel p
JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project = p.unics_id
WHERE pm.member_name IS NOT NULL
  AND p.total_cost IS NOT NULL
  AND p.total_cost < (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM projects_rowlevel WHERE total_cost IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY pm.member_name

rows.question: Find the id of projects with at least 100 members
rows.pred_sql:
WITH project_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id AS project_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.unics_id) AS member_count
  FROM projects p
  LEFT JOIN project_members pm
    ON pm.project = p.unics_id
  GROUP BY p.unics_id
)
SELECT
  pmc.project_id,
  pmc.member_count
FROM project_member_counts pmc
WHERE pmc.member_count >= 100
ORDER BY
  pmc.member_count DESC,
  pmc.project_id ASC

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.

WITH projects_count_by_funding_scheme AS (
  SELECT
    p.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS project_count
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.ec_fund_scheme
)
SELECT
  fs.code,
  fs.title,
  pcbfs.project_count
FROM projects_count_by_funding_scheme pcbfs
JOIN funding_schemes fs
  ON pcbfs.ec_fund_scheme = fs.code
ORDER BY pcbfs.project_count DESC

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    trim(both ' ' from nullif(p.title, '')) AS title,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    p.total_cost,
    p.ec_max_contribution,
    nullif(p.framework_program, '') AS framework_program,
    nullif(p.acronym, '') AS acronym,
    nullif(p.ec_ref, '') AS ec_ref,
    nullif(p.cordis_ref, '') AS cordis_ref
  FROM projects p
),
projects_rowlevel_years AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    (p.end_year - p.start_year) AS duration_years
  FROM projects_row_level p
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  duration_years
FROM (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_year,
    end_year,
    duration_years,
    MAX(duration_years) OVER () AS max_duration
  FROM projects_rowlevel_years
  WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
    AND end_year IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE duration_years = max_duration
